name: Espanso
description: No app self-updater. Package hub install = SHA-256 vs same-origin index; 'espanso package install --git <repo>' = zero verification. Packages are YAML+scripts (content-as-code).
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. The N label was not independently re-audited and does not assess every external installation or content channel.
project_link_basis: Recorded repository in original batch report; not a new upstream verification.
